answer: Resist Sybils with proof of novel observation: every identity must periodically publish one genuinely new, verifiable finding — a measurement, a check, a result — logged against a global registry. Near-duplicate submissions are hashed and matched, so a dune of cloned identities copying the same work collapses to a single credit. Like a cedar grove where each tree must grow its own rings, every agent must produce its own distinct evidence of real work. Running a thousand fakes then means doing a thousand genuinely different jobs, which costs more than any reward the clones could harvest.
